documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Rolex Rings reported a 43% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 revenue from operations to Rs. 389 crore, driven by a 68% growth in automotive components. EBITDA grew 72% YoY to Rs. 94 crore with an EBITDA margin of 24.2%, despite higher ocean freight and fuel costs following the West Asia conflict. Management stated that monthly order inflows average between Rs.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings expects H2 FY27 performance to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate revenues from the defence and aerospace segment over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident in achieving mid-teen revenue growth in fiscal '27.
guidance.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

guidance.claim: Revenue growth is expected to be in the mid-teens for fiscal '27 and could reach close to 20% in fiscal '28.
guidance.quote: On the revenue part, as I have indicated, mid-teen; we are a bit confident till now for fiscal '27 and maybe more than mid-teen or coming close to the 20% number for fiscal '28.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins for fiscal '27 are conservatively expected to be between 21% and 22%.
guidance.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings management has given mid-teen growth guidance for the rest of FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive components led Q2 FY27 growth, expanding 68% to Rs. 177 crore with segment exports up 89%.
demand_outlook.quote: Automotive components led the quarter, growing 68% to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in this segment up 89%.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers who had held back orders during FY26 are placing orders again while new programs won last year are scaling up.
demand_outlook.quote: Customers who held back through FY26 are placing orders with confidence again, and the new programmes we won last year are now scaling up.

demand_outlook.claim: US tariffs have not impacted Rolex Rings' business.
demand_outlook.quote: US tariffs have not impacted our business.

demand_outlook.claim: US automotive revenues for the company more than doubled year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's order book remained healthy through Q1 FY27, with execution being the constraint rather than demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Though this looks short of our guided growth, our order book through the quarter was healthy, and the constraint we faced was not demand.

demand_outlook.claim: US customers are coming back and re-engaging after a prolonged period of caution.
demand_outlook.quote: The US market is coming back with the customers reengaging after a prolonged period of caution.

demand_outlook.claim: European demand continues to be strong due to expanding automotive components presence.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to fire on the back of our expanding automotive components presence there.

demand_outlook.claim: Softness in bearing rings was concentrated in the industrial segment in domestic and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The bearing rings softness was concentrated in the industrial business or in the industrial segment, particularly in the domestic and European market, an area where we have flagged our broader industry-wide stagnancy in the past, and it reflects the same labor-driven output constraint that affected quarter too.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas customers who held back during FY26 have resumed placing orders with confidence.
demand_outlook.quote: What stands out most is a change in customer behaviour - buyers who had been cautious and holding back through FY26 are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a genuine pickup in overseas demand based on customer ordering shifts.
demand_outlook.quote: This shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up.

demand_outlook.claim: US business is returning to normal and has not been affected by US tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the US imposing tariffs, business has not been affected and is coming back to normalcy.

capex_expansion.claim: Supplies to one to two new customer plants are scheduled to begin in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

capex_expansion.claim: Rolex Rings is in discussions with a large OEM in Europe for commercial vehicle and industrial products.
capex_expansion.quote: In Europe, we continue to build on our expanding automotive presence and are in discussions with a large OEM for commercial vehicle and industrial products.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 9MW solar plant is set to be installed by Mid-CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex target for the company is in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores year-on-year.
capex_expansion.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore at a 24.2% margin, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore including a one-time receipt.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore considering one time receipt.

margins_costs.claim: The company faced cost pressures from a near three-fold rise in ocean freight, as well as higher fuel and consumable costs following the escalation of the West Asia conflict.
margins_costs.quote: We delivered this despite a near three-fold rise in ocean freight ,higher fuel cost and consumable costs following the escalation of the West Asia conflict.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 22.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 4% to Rs. 304 crores alongside improved gross margins and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 4% to Rs. 304 crores with Gross Margins & profitability improving.

margins_costs.claim: Rolex Rings expanded its EBITDA margin to 22.6% in Q1 FY27 from 21.1% in Q1 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings' order book averages between Rs. 120 crore and Rs. 125 crore per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book continues to remain strong, averaging in the range of Rs.120 crores to Rs 125 crores per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Normalization of the labor situation from the start of the quarter enabled conversion of order book into planned output.
orders_capacity.quote: With the labour situation fully normalised from the start of the quarter, we were able to convert this order book into output at the pace we had planned.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings has a total production capacity of 1,65,000 MTPA.
Current plant utilization level stands between 63% and 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are at the same 63% to 65% utilization, you can say.

orders_capacity.claim: Management targets utilization levels to reach 70% to 72%.
orders_capacity.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded its highest monthly revenue since inception in July 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: I would like to inform or pleased to inform that in month July '26, we recorded the highest revenue since the inception of our operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings maintained a healthy order book throughout Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed a Rs. 180 crore buyback and maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: With a debt-free balance sheet, the Rs. 180 crore buyback completed, and a strong pipeline across Europe, the US and India, we head into H2 FY27 with confidence.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed an INR 180 crores buyback of 1 crore equity shares, without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Would like to inform you that our INR180 crores buyback of 1 crores equity shares concluded during the quarter, with the promoter group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed directly to non-promoter shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings is currently fully debt-free and clear of legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed a Rs. 180 crore buyback in Q1 FY27 without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 180 crore buyback got concluded during the quarter, with the Promoter Group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed to our public shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt-free and has settled all legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: Aso of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalation of the West Asia conflict caused a near three-fold rise in ocean freight along with higher fuel and consumable costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: We delivered this despite a near three-fold rise in ocean freight ,higher fuel cost and consumable costs following the escalation of the West Asia conflict.

risks_headwinds.claim: A labor shortage on the shop floor hindered output conversion during part of the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

risks_headwinds.claim: Availability of export containers at reasonable cost remains an issue due to ocean freight increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, availability of containers at a proper cost is an issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations faced constraints due to labor availability rather than end-market demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: The constraint was labour availability, not demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: A shortage of shop floor workers slowed the rate of converting order book into output.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of workers on the shop floor meant we couldn't convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted.

management_commitments.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

management_commitments.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to increase capacity utilization to 70%-72%.
management_commitments.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

management_commitments.claim: Rolex Rings targets annual capex in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores.
management_commitments.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.
